*Advances Phunware 2.0 Rollout, with Four Major Hospitality Groups in Discussions*


*Gross Profit Increases 61.2%; Gross Margin Expands to 56.7% from 38.1%*


*Ends Quarter with $86.7 Million in Cash and No Debt*


AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Phunware, Inc. (“Phunware” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: PHUN), a provider of AI-enabled guest intelligence software to operators of hotels, resorts, and other large, complex properties, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Management Commentary**


“We made meaningful progress on Phunware 2.0 during the third quarter, both in how we develop products and how we reach customers,” said Dmitry Kroshka, Chief Executive Officer of Phunware. “Instead of selling a custom app to one resort at a time, we are building a modular platform that can work with customers’ existing systems and reach entire groups of properties. Since June, our rebuilt sales and marketing team has generated nearly 300 leads and we are in discussions with four major hospitality flags and ownership groups. Our priority is converting that interest into signed agreements and recurring revenue.


“Our product development is keeping pace with that opportunity. AI Concierge is commercially available, Itinerary Planner entered beta in September, and Operator Console demonstrations begin in November. By making these modules available without requiring operators to replace their existing apps, we believe we can reach a much larger hospitality market, with opportunities to apply much of the same technology into healthcare. We are investing in the AI product, data, and technology capabilities needed to support this expansion, while strengthening our sales and marketing efforts. These investments are reflected in our higher operating expenses as we work to translate product development and commercial interest into revenue.


“We recognize that this progress needs to translate into financial results. Our Board has been actively involved in reviewing and refining the Phunware 2.0 strategy, providing valuable operating, financial, and capital markets experience as we execute our growth plan. We ended the quarter with $86.7 million in cash, no debt, and no equity capital raised during the first nine months of the year. That financial flexibility allows us to continue investing in organic growth. We remain focused on delivering the results that matter to shareholders: signed customer agreements, growing recurring revenue, and disciplined use of capital,” concluded Kroshka.


**Recent Business Highlights**


- Announced an agreement to expand AI Concierge at Wailea Beach Resort, where more than 70% of guests use Phunware’s app during their stay and over 30% use it to discover new experiences. The resort leads its sister properties in Hawaii in ancillary revenue.
- Advanced Itinerary Planner into beta in September, with Operator Console demonstrations beginning in November. Phunware’s modular products are designed to work with existing property apps, expanding its potential U.S. hospitality market to an estimated 30,000 to 40,000 properties rated three stars and above.
- Published a case study involving a major destination and entertainment operator in Pennsylvania, covering more than 630,000 square feet of mapped indoor space across multiple lodging properties, and generating nearly 65,000 dining-information views and more than 23,000 navigation routes over 14 months.
- Advanced healthcare capabilities, with appointment and check-in features targeted for beta in the first quarter of 2027 and work underway toward a potential patient-portal integration, subject to approval.
- Wound down the advertising business to concentrate resources on software subscriptions, services, and Phunware 2.0, further aligning operations with the Company’s recurring-revenue strategy.
- Participated in the LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event in October, where CEO Dmitry Kroshka presented the Phunware 2.0 strategy and hosted one-on-one investor meetings.
- In November, initiated a cost savings plan by reducing both full-time and contract headcount, which is estimated to provide approximately $2.0 million in annualized savings.


**Financial Highlights**


- Net revenue increased 8.3% to $483,000 in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $446,000 in the third quarter of 2025, primarily reflecting software subscription contracts delivered in late 2025. For the first nine months of 2026, net revenue increased 15.8% to $1.8 million, compared to $1.5 million in the prior-year period.
- Gross profit increased 61.2% to $274,000 in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $170,000 in the prior-year period, while gross margin expanded to 56.7% from 38.1%. For the first nine months of 2026, gross profit increased 67.8% to $1.2 million, with gross margin expanding to 66.3% from 45.8%.
- Cash and cash equivalents totaled $86.7 million as of September 30, 2026, with no debt and no equity capital raised during the first nine months of 2026, providing financial flexibility to continue executing the Company’s Phunware 2.0 strategy.
- Net loss was $7.1 million, or $(0.34) per basic and diluted share in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $2.4 million, or $(0.12) per basic and diluted share in the prior-year period. The increase primarily reflects $2.0 million of additional litigation-related legal expenses, as well as increased investment in AI product development, technology personnel, and sales and marketing initiatives supporting Phunware 2.0.
- Adjusted EBITDA loss from continuing operations was $7.3 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $3.3 million in the prior-year period. For the first nine months of 2026, Adjusted EBITDA loss was $16.6 million, compared to $11.9 million in the prior-year period.
- Net cash used in operating activities was $13.9 million for the first nine months of 2026, compared to $9.3 million in the prior-year period.


*Note: In September 2026, Phunware committed to winding down its advertising business, which is reported as a discontinued operation. Unless otherwise noted, financial results above reflect continuing operations, and prior-period results have been recast for comparability.*


**Note about Non-GAAP Financial Measures**


A non-GAAP financial measure is a numerical measure of a company’s performance, financial position, or cash flows that either excludes or includes amounts that are not normally excluded or included in the most directly comparable measure calculated and presented in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America, or GAAP. Non-GAAP measures are not in accordance with, nor are they a substitute for, GAAP measures. Other companies may use different non-GAAP measures and presentation of results.


In addition to financial results presented in accordance with GAAP, this press release presents adjusted EBITDA, which is a non-GAAP measure. Adjusted EBITDA is determined by taking net loss from continuing operations and adding interest expense (income), income tax expense, depreciation, and further adjusted for non-cash impairment, valuation adjustments and stock-based compensation expense. The company believes that this non-GAAP measure, viewed in addition to and not in lieu of net loss, provides additional information to investors by providing a more focused measure of operating results. This metric is an integral part of the Company’s internal reporting to evaluate its operations and the performance of senior management. A reconciliation of adjusted EBITDA to net loss from continuing operations, the most comparable GAAP measure, is available in the accompanying financial tables below. The non-GAAP measure presented herein may not be comparable to similarly titled measures presented by other companies.

**About Phunware**


Phunware, Inc. (NASDAQ: PHUN) is an enterprise software company building an AI-enabled Guest Intelligence Platform for operators of hotels, resorts, healthcare facilities and other complex properties. Its Phunware 2.0 strategy combines mobile engagement, proprietary location-aware technology and modular AI products to help operators improve guest and patient experiences, better understand on-property activity and identify new revenue opportunities.


For more information on Phunware, please visit[www.phunware.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=xGhz0qXfZhQfNYcyhEB4UeHKRWPzw6m4BTpXS12Pu8Ve2oDVIMt6SOIu--ntmNwmmeSKkfrk4Hq7jh9_V8WJZilLqrh5aHTlG65K0kU8r64=) .
